content.text: | # | Feature | What it should do | Your example | |---|---|---|---| | 14.1 | Abstract | Write the beginning of a short paper with a title, an author line, and an abstract set apart from the body. | ` itle{Ringing Bells} \author{A. Author} \maketitle egin{abstract}We study bell resonance.\end{abstract}` | | 14.2 | Title block with affiliations and keywords | Write a paper's title block with two authors, each with a university affiliation, and a list of keywords. | ` itle{Ringing Bells} \author{A. Author, MIT \and B. Writer, Stanford} \keywords{acoustics; bells; resonance}` | | 14.3 | Theorem and proof | Write a short mathematical passage with a numbered theorem followed by its proof, ending with an end-of-proof mark. | ` egin{theorem} There are infinitely many primes. \end{theorem} egin{proof} Suppose not. Multiply all primes and add 1. \qed \end{proof}` | | 14.4 | Numbered definition | Write a numbered definition of a prime number, set apart from the surrounding text the way math books do. | ` egin{definition} A prime is an integer $p>1$ whose only positive divisors are $1$ and $p$. \end{definition}` | | 14.5 | Epigraph | Write the opening of a chapter with a short epigraph quotation and its attribution, set apart before the first paragraph. | `\chapter{Departure} \epigraph{The road goes ever on.}{J.R.R. Tolkien} It began on a Tuesday.` | | 14.6 | Pull quote | Write a paragraph of an article and a pull quote that repeats a striking line from it in larger type. | `The river rose all night, and the town woke to water in its kitchens. \pullquote{The rivers were rising faster than anyone admitted.}` | | 14.7 | Framed box | Write a paragraph followed by a short piece of text inside a framed box. | `Installing the driver takes a few minutes. egin{tcolorbox} Note: back up your files first. \end{tcolorbox}` | | 14.8 | Algorithm in pseudocode | Write a short algorithm in numbered pseudocode with the caption 'Binary search'. | ` egin{algorithm} \caption{Binary search} egin{algorithmic}[1] \State $lo \gets 0$ \State $hi \gets n-1$ \end{algorithmic} \end{algorithm}` | | 14.9 | Subfigures | Write a passage with two images shown side by side, each with its own sub-caption (a) and (b), and one overall caption. | ` egin{figure} \subfloat[Front]{\includegraphics{a.png}} \subfloat[Side]{\includegraphics{b.png}} \caption{Two views of the bell.} \end{figure}` | | 14.10 | Reference to a page number | Write a sentence that refers to the page number where the section called Results begins, so the number updates automatically. | `The findings are summarized on page~\pageref{sec:results}. \section{Results}\label{sec:results}` | | 14.11 | List of figures | Write a short document outline that includes an automatically generated list of figures. | `\section{Introduction} \listoffigures \section{Results}` | | 14.12 | Appendix | Write a short document with two main sections followed by an appendix labeled with a letter. | `\section{Methods} \section{Results} \appendix \section{Raw data}` | | 14.13 | Acronyms spelled out on first use | Write two sentences that use the acronym API, so that its first use is spelled out automatically and it appears in a generated list of acronyms. | `We query the \gls{api} for weather data. The \gls{api} returns JSON. \printglossaries` | | 14.14 | Units and quantities | Write a sentence giving a speed of 3.5 × 10^8 meters per second and a temperature of 21 degrees Celsius, with the units typeset correctly. | `The signal travels at \SI{3.5e8}{\meter\per\second} in a room at \SI{21}{\celsius}.` | | 14.15 | Chemical equation | Write the balanced chemical equation for burning methane, typeset as chemistry. | `\ce{CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O}` | | 14.16 | Margin to-do note | Write a paragraph with an editorial to-do note attached to it, shown in the margin. | `The method reduces error by half. odo{Add a citation for this claim.}` | | 14.17 | Line numbers for review | Write a short paragraph set up so that the printed version shows line numbers in the margin for reviewers. | `\linenumbers The method performs well on all benchmarks.` | | 14.18 | Drop cap | Write the first paragraph of a story with its first letter set as a large drop cap. | `\lettrine[lines=3]{O}{nce} upon a time, a lighthouse keeper lived alone on a rock.` | | 14.19 | Hyphenation hints | Write a sentence containing the word electroencephalography, marking the places where it may be hyphenated. | `The patient underwent electro\-en\-ceph\-a\-lo\-gra\-phy yesterday.` | | 14.20 | Numbered paragraphs | Write three paragraphs of a contract that are numbered 1.1, 1.2 and 1.3 automatically. | ` egin{enumerate}[label=1.\arabic*] \item The Seller delivers the goods. \item The Buyer pays within 30 days. \item Disputes go to arbitration. \end{enumerate}` | | 14.21 | Colored text | Write a sentence where the word 'blocked' is shown in red text. | `The door is extcolor{red}{blocked}.` | | 14.22 | Subtext line | Write a heading followed by a line of small, muted subtext under it. | `# Results Preliminary, subject to change` | | 14.23 | Inline badge | Write a sentence ending with a small colored badge that reads 'beta'. | `Export to PDF is available beta` | | 14.24 | Inline data fields | Write a note about a book that includes a rating of 5 and a genre of mystery as data fields a query tool could read. | `I loved The Hollow Man [rating:: 5] [genre:: mystery].` | | 14.25 | Key-value list | Write a short list of facts about a person (name, year born, occupation) that should display as aligned key-value pairs. | `:Name: Ada Lovelace :Born: 1815 :Occupation: mathematician` | | 14.26 | Side-brace grouping | Write three related lines grouped together by a large curly brace with a label beside it. | `\left. egin{array}{l}x = 1\y = 2\z = 3\end{array} ight\} ext{coordinates}` | | 14.27 | Table formula | Write a small table of expenses whose total row is computed by a formula. | `Item,Cost Rent,900 Food,350 Total,=SUM(B2:B3)` | | 14.28 | Callout on one list item | Write a bulleted list where one item is highlighted as a warning by a marker at the start of that item. | `- Install the package - > [!WARNING] Do not run as root - Restart the server` | | 14.29 | Note template | Write a daily-note template that inserts today's date and the note's title automatically when a note is created. | `# {{title}} Date: {{date:YYYY-MM-DD}}` | | 14.30 | Inline icon | Write a sentence with a small heart icon from an icon set shown inline. | `I aHeart\ this project.` |
